description: Distilled knowledge profile. No args: recent topic index (capped). With topic: full document. Pass limit for a larger or full index.

limit.description: Max topics in the index (most recently updated first). Default 20 when omitted. Pass 0 for every topic.

topic.description: Optional topic slug or name. When set, returns the full topic document instead of the index.
